title: Relocate self-documentation out of the adopter docs tree
description:
jit self-documentation sits in the adopter-facing docs/ tree, contradicting that tree's own charter (permanent, user-facing, domain-agnostic): the v1.0 milestone charter at docs/ root, two skill-eval records in docs/reference/, and a repo-local skills-sync sentence in README. The rules-and-gates reference renders this repository's own gate registries without signalling that.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The milestone charter and skill-eval records live under dev/, with issue-linked paths re-linked at their final locations
- [hard] REQ-02: README contains no repo-local skills-sync convention
- [hard] REQ-03: The rules-and-gates reference presents the projection mechanism as the shipped feature and marks the rendered region as this repository's registries serving as a live example
- [hard] REQ-04: The configured projection target for rules-and-gates rendering remains valid after any moves
